title: Ratecard shift: launch orchestration and cross-team comms for pricing & limits
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Scope: Coordinate a coordinated launch for the new ratecard and limits model across Product, Engineering, Billing, Legal, Marketing, Support, and Sales. This ticket centralizes the operational checklist for: SKU definitions and stable identifiers, per-route and per-model limits, billing system mapping (metering keys and invoices), release notes and developer-facing change log, sales enablement materials and Q&A, and the cross-team readiness gates. Goal: minimize billing surprises, provide clear migration paths for existing customers, and ensure CS/Sales are equipped to handle questions on day 0.

acceptance_criteria: All SKU IDs published in the canonical catalog and referenced by Console and Billing
Billing generates accurate sample invoices for three representative customer profiles
Release notes published and linked from Console change log prior to public rollout
Sales enablement deck approved and distributed, with an internal Q&A session recorded
Support has a searchable FAQ and escalation path documented in the internal KB
Engineering feature flag and rollback plan validated in staging canary runs
Monitoring dashboards show baseline metrics and alert thresholds are configured

rollout_steps: Week -3: Finalize SKUs, legal sign-off, and Sales enablement prep
Week -2: Publish release notes draft, prepare marketing comms, complete design changes in Console
Week -1: Billing dry-run invoices, support FAQ ready, Sales Q&A session
Day 0 (canary): Open rollout to 5% of traffic for Dedicated and Hosted tiers, monitor alerts
Day 1 (gradual): If no alerts, increase to 25% then 75% over 24 hours; engage manual approvals at each step
Day 3: Full rollout complete; run reconciliation jobs for invoices generated during migration window
Post-launch (Week +1): Hold retrospective, capture lessons learned, finalize migration playbook
blockers: ENG-3120: Final validation of per-route enforcement logic in runtime (currently failing one unit test)
Open question: whether streaming tokens should be billed at per-token or per-chunk granularity — Finance to decide by 2025-03-09
Marketing approval delay if legal requests language changes to customer-facing comms
notes: Trade-offs: aggressive rollout reduces time to value but increases risk of invoice mismatches. Recommend canary window for billing reconciliation before broad customer notification. For enterprise customers on Reserved capacity, coordinate direct outreach and provide a one-to-one migration plan. Post-launch analytics should prioritize billing deltas and support friction signals for 72 hours.
customer_communication_plan: Pre-launch: Private notice to customers on Reserved/Dedicated plans with migration options (email + account manager contact)
Launch day: Public blog post + in-console banner highlighting the change and link to the migration guide
7-day follow-up: FAQ update and webinar recording for customers who want deeper context
30-day: Reminder notice and last-call for opt-in migration for impacted legacy SKUs
